subject: Search Engine
source_sentence: These seed terms were combined into a set of 3000 3- tuple (3T) and a set of 3000 2-tuple (2T) search queries, i.e. two-word terms were enclosed in inverted commas to form one single term for the search engine.
title: PaddyWaC: A Minimally-Supervised Web-Corpus of Hiberno-English
